reviews.t: Fresh.  Clean.  Awe
reviews.x: It all started when my wife said, "I love a man with some scruff."  You see, I'm a chronic shaver.  Love the clean look.  That was until it finally dawned on me to be smart and let the facial hair grow for a bit.  I never wanted a full beard, so I kept my beard trimmed to have that rugged look.  [Maybe I'm at least rugged in my own mind.]  The darn problem was that annoying "beard itch".  Since I never have the luxurious beard of a true outdoorsman, I frequently get the prickly, dry sensation of

reviews.t: A personal eucalyptus steam room for your face.
reviews.x: I dig this beard oil a lot. The smell is very refreshing, I pick up more of the eucalyptus than the spearmint, but I like both, so they are very much welcome. A lot of higher end products use peppermint, so I was very curious about it. It's light, and complimentary, so it will stay with you in the morning, and fade off by lunch.  The quality of the oil is p. good, I have a thicker beard, so this sets the sides of my beard nicely, without letting it puff out if I put no product in. However, I sti

reviews.t: 2 bits man totally does it right!
reviews.x: This product is absolutely the best! I've used both the "fresh" and the "classic" and have been nothing but satisfied with the product! It softens and conditions your beard while making you smell absolutely manly! I would definitely recommend it to everyone with a beard!

reviews.t: It smells like a delicious peppermint dream ON MY FACE
reviews.x: I just can't get enough of this oil! 1. It smells like a delicious peppermint dream ON MY FACE. 2. It makes my beard super soft and tamed all the crazy beard hairs that are trying to escape. 3. I feel like once I started using this, my beard started growing a little faster. This may be because it moisturizes so well or because I have so much fun putting it on. 4. After I apply this to my beard, I run my hands and the comb through my other hair which has been looking the healthiest it has in year

reviews.t: Inconsistent product
reviews.x: Had to order it twice because the first time they just didn't send it, now I get the second order and it has absolutely no scent. I've been using 2 bits man for years now and have to say I am disappointed with their quality lately. They are inconsistent and unpredictable, I will be looking for a new manufacturer if this company doesn't step it up.

reviews.t: Fresh should have been labeled as mint
reviews.x: Your whole beard will smell like your gum. Was hopefully for more of a fresh clean or citrus aroma. Bummed on the scent, but great quality oil and price

reviews.t: It smells exactly like a wet bag of cedar mulch
reviews.x: It smells exactly like a wet bag of cedar mulch. I can't even smell the peppermint. I don't like it.

reviews.t: After several brands, 2 Bits is still my Go-To
reviews.x: I have gone through quite a few different kinds of beard oil while trying to save money or find a better brand, but 2 Bits was the first I ever tried and the last one I will use. I've tossed out several half bottles of other kinds after having to use so much for similar results or just not getting anything out of it. 2 Bits by far lets you use the least amount of oil for the best results. My face feels so much happier, especially in the winter, when I get in a good routine of using some of their

reviews.t: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.x: i have used the 2 bit unscented oil before and was very happy with the quality of the product so when I saw a $1 bottle promotion I jumped on it despite fearing that I would not like a heavily mint odor... Boy am I glad I did! Despite the label listing eucalyptus and spearmint on the front, this oil also has a solid cedar wood base. This makes for a very nice refreshing scent when first applied which tames down into a more "manly" mix containing a conservative cedar base note. My fears o

reviews.t: My now preferred oil on Amazon
reviews.x: This is a truly great product.  I've tried other beard oils that are entirely too oily. This product is certainly oil-based but I feel that I am able to control the amount I use much better than other brands. The flow Cyril piece at the top of the bottle actually dispenses a true drop and not a dollop that I have experienced with other brands. I was a little worried about the fragrance but I find it to be more subtle than overwhelming and I don't even notice it a few minutes after applying. My w

reviews.t: Yeah, it does the job
reviews.x: Is this the miracle oil that many reviews claim? Yes and no. My favorite thing about this oil is that it doesn't smell like oil or anything weird. It smells actually really nice and refreshing, and it's a smell I wouldn't mind as a cologne or lotion. That's the reason I picked this one because I heard other beard oils smell weird, and for my wife that would have been a big no no.  Does it work? Yes! I could definitely feel that it made my beard softer, and I suppose it did take any beard itch aw

reviews.t: Works well for itchy beards and dandruff.
reviews.x: I got The 2 Bits Man Premium Beard Oil - Eucalyptus & Spearmint scent for my husband. He tends to get dandruff in his beard that causes him to have to shave it every so often due to the itchiness and flaking. He noticed immediate itch relief after his first application. The essential oils went right to work soothing his skin and conditioning his beard. The scent is minty goodness. We both really like how it smells, and a little bit goes a long way. It only takes a couple drops for a short, full

reviews.t: Beardly man approves
reviews.x: I hate 5 star ratings... but I would be lying if I did not feel that this beard oil is worthy of 5 stars. The "fresh" scent is so pleasing on a summer day and the oil helps to maintain my long and always drying beard. A few dabs of this in the morning and right after a shower keeps my beard healthy despite the hot climates I frequent. On a separate note, my wife thinks they may slipping some kind of pheromone in it as it scent is "irresistible" to her. A great product from a grea

reviews.t: I have been using this oil for a couple of ...
reviews.x: I have been using this oil for a couple of weeks now and can feel a difference in my beard. The smell is not over bearing and I can't even notice it in my beard after a few minutes. I will definitely be trying difference scents.  There is nothing wrong with taking care of your beard. Unless you live in the woods. Get some oils and balm and take care of that face. This stuff keeps your face from drying out. Now I just have to talk my wife into letting me grow it down to my belly button...lol

reviews.t: and a beautiful shine to it
reviews.x: My niece hates when my beard is "prickly" but this beard oil changed all that. My beard has never felt nicer. I wish they came in larger jars but that is my only con to this stuff. It makes my beard soft, smelling fresh, and a beautiful shine to it. It doesn't feel greasy like I thought it might. It also works great in the hair too. Between the beard and the hair, I've never looked better and I no longer need to buy cologne while I am smelling minty fresh.

reviews.t: Excellent product that works well and smells excellent.
reviews.x: Very pleased with the quality and scent of this beard oil, it applies easily and evenly and doesn't leave any residue on your beard or hands. Smell is very clean and minty without being overpowering. It keeps my beard smooth and silky and really helps moisturize both beard and underlying skin. The bottle doesn't have an eyedropper but rather a plastic insert that makes measuring out a few drops simple and easy. I would recommend and will purchase again.

reviews.t: Great feeling oil
reviews.x: Great feeling oil... feels nice on my skin.  I'm not giving it five stars because the scent is a little strong for me, almost over-powering when I use as much oil as I want to use.  Now, this may be my fault, because I like to use A LOT of beard oil.  The scent is nice, but strong.  I would still and will buy it again.  I've been mixing it with unscented oil and making it to the degree of strength I want.

reviews.t: Great oil!
reviews.x: This oil is a really nice, light oil. My beard is approximately 6 inches long. I have very coarse, wirey hair that is hard to tame. After using this oil for about a month now I've noticed a significant difference in the softness. The eucalyptus scent is a surprisingly pleasing aroma, and it is also good for the skin underneath. Great buy for the price, and I will definitely purchase again.

reviews.t: Great company great product line.
reviews.x: I love everything about the two bits man company all their sons are very masculine and they are very light in terms of weight did you not make you feel like you have a heavy beard. And that's the one thing I truly like about the product is that it doesn't feel like you have oil smeared all over your face. Also I cannot express how awesome their customer service is.

reviews.t: Great product, but maybe a different scent.
reviews.x: This particular scent isn't something I'm in love with. It smells good, just not for me. I'm using it anyway and it's doing great for my dry skin and beard texture. So far it's about two months and there's still plenty left, and that's with not quite a full beard.  I'll be getting a different scent but the product itself is great.

reviews.t: The Best Gift She Ever Got Me
reviews.x: Such a wonderful product. I got this as a gift from my girlfriend and have used it for a few weeks. The smell is wonderful and wakes me up in the morning. I have noticed my beard has felt thicker and shapes much easier. I really recommend this Minnesota made product and will be trying their other oils soon.

reviews.t: Smells great and fresh!
reviews.x: Ahh the smell is incredible on my face. I've been  using it daily and I seriously love it. I used to use just regular Jojoba oil but I wanted something scented. You can tell this is quality oil when you apply it to your beard. My hair is thick so I use a couple more drops than the directions indicate.

reviews.t: Really like this scent its lite but I can still smell ...
reviews.x: Really like this scent its lite but I can still smell it all day which is enjoyable.  It's priced fairly which is not common in beard oils especially when it's so easy to make your own. But this one I will definitely buy again even if I dabble in making some of my own. Buy it and try it it's worth it.

reviews.t: it's much softer and more comfortable when I use this than when I don't
reviews.x: Softens the hair on my beard (which is on the fuller side). However, it does still leave a bit of beard dandruff behind which I use a little Head and Shoulders to clear up. But overall, it's much softer and more comfortable when I use this than when I don't. Suggest to use throughout the day

reviews.t: Wife purchased, Husband approved :)
reviews.x: I got this as a gift for my husband. He was hesitant to try it out as he doesn't generally use foo foo (his term) grooming products but he really liked the scent and actually stated that he would use it again.  I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent as fresh, pleasant, and not overpowering.
Many reviewers say the oil softens, conditions, and tames their beard.
Some reviewers report scent disappointment, describing it as minty, cedar-like, or absent rather than fresh or citrus.
Reviewers report relief from itchy beards and beard dandruff.
A few reviewers note inconsistent product quality or missing shipments.
